cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

mechanism: A copies audience-ending behavior without understanding it and seeks reassurance that remaining through speech was enough.
confusable: D100 asks enough, not D90 inventing a repair process.
seedUse: Keep B future practice offer making A ask permission to stop working.
